bullets.text: In-Country Data Processing Expansion - **Microsoft** enhances data sovereignty for **Microsoft 365 Copilot** in 15 countries, including the **UK**.
AI's Cybersecurity Dilemma - **Microsoft** highlights the dual nature of AI in cybersecurity, presenting both opportunities and risks.
European Cybersecurity Regulations - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of new EU regulations for securing critical infrastructure.
Generative AI in Security Operations - **Microsoft Security Copilot** leverages generative AI to enhance security operations and reduce alert fatigue.
Passkey Integration in Edge - **Microsoft Edge** now supports passkey saving and syncing, enhancing online security.
New Threat: SesameOp Backdoor - **Microsoft** uncovers a backdoor using the **OpenAI Assistants API** for covert command and control.
GitHub Universe Highlights - **Microsoft** showcases innovations in developer collaboration and AI integration at **GitHub Universe 2025**.
Generative AI Security Threats - **Microsoft** releases an e-book detailing critical generative AI security threats organizations must address.
